commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.
90+3' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jeremy Le Douaron departs the field of play to be replaced by Axel Camblan (Brest).
88' Substitution. Romain Del Castillo walks off the pitch and Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) comes on as a substitute.
84' Khephren Thuram (Nice) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
83' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a change. Evann Guessand (Nice) replaces Terem Moffi.
79' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) was too forceful with his tackle and Romain Lissorgue interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
78' Martin Satriano (Brest) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
75' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Steve Mounie walks off the pitch to be replaced by Martin Satriano (Brest).
75' Mahdi Camara will be replaced by Kamory Doumbia (Brest).
74' Francesco Farioli decides to make a substitution. Gaetan Laborde will be replaced by Badredine Bouanani (Nice).
71' Jeremie Boga (Nice) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jonas Martin (Brest) comes onto the pitch so that Hugo Magnetti can be given a rest.
68' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jordan Lotomba (Nice) for Youcef Atal.
68' Francesco Farioli has decided to substitute Morgan Sanson and he is replaced by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice).
68' It is time for a substitution. Pablo Rosario (Nice) is on for Jean-Clair Todibo.
67' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
67' Kenny Lala (Brest) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Marcin Bulka to dive and make a save.
66' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
64' Jeremie Boga (Nice) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
62' Romain Lissorgue shows a yellow card to Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) for his blatant foul.
61' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Romain Del Castillo (Brest). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
61' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Brest will have a corner.
59' Youcef Atal (Nice) gets a yellow card.
58' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
58' Mahdi Camara (Brest) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Brest are awarded a corner kick.
54' Bradley Locko (Brest) brings an opponent down and Romain Lissorgue interrupts the game.
52' Khephren Thuram (Nice) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
50' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
48' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Morgan Sanson (Nice) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45+2' Looks like Morgan Sanson (Nice) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
45+2' Poor challenge! Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is penalised for tripping and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle. Nice win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
42' One of the players from Brest times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
38' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
38' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle as Terem Moffi (Nice) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
35' Melvin Bard (Nice) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
34' Mahdi Camara (Brest) picks up a yellow card.
33' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
29' Morgan Sanson (Nice) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

29' A huge opportunity wasted! Khephren Thuram (Nice) produces a header from a rebound around the penalty spot. His effort is denied by one of the defenders who is well positioned and clears the ball to safety.
27' Neat passing move from Nice in order to create new attacking opportunities.
27' Kenny Lala (Brest) meets a perfect cross on the edge of the box and rips a shot that goes well wide of the right post.
25' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) swings it in and Romain Del Castillo gets on the end of it, but Marcin Bulka shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
24' The resulting corner from Morgan Sanson (Nice) is cleared by the defence.
23' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Nice have been awarded a corner kick.

20' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. His dangerous effort is blocked by Marco Bizot, who makes a glorious save!
18' That's a well-taken pass by Mahdi Camara (Brest). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
15' Great solo effort from Gaetan Laborde (Nice)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post.
14' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
13' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
11' A lofted cross from Jeremie Boga (Nice) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
9' Morgan Sanson (Nice) is penalised for a foul. Romain Lissorgue had a clear view and blows his whistle.
8' OFF THE POST! Good play from Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes the left post!
7' Jeremie Boga (Nice) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
7' Nice work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
6' Jeremie Boga (Nice) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
6' Morgan Sanson (Nice) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
5' Morgan Sanson (Nice) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
5' Steve Mounie (Brest) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
4' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) makes a slide tackle, but referee Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul.
3' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
1' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends a long ball in, but Marcin Bulka comfortably gathers the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Brest will kick the game off.
Romain Lissorgue will referee today's match.
